title: Can both happen at once?

predict.q: A price-taking firm always produces where **P = MC**. You set the market price. As the price changes, will the firm also produce at **minimum ATC**?

options.fb: Watch the ATC light: at 43 the firm produces 40 units, where ATC is 28, above its minimum of 26. P = MC does not guarantee minimum ATC.
Both lights are on only at a price of 26: P = MC = minimum ATC, at 30 units.

options.s: Never: P = MC and minimum ATC cannot happen together
options.fb: At a price of 26 both lights come on: P = MC = minimum ATC. This is the long-run outcome of perfect competition (a later mission).

task: Move the **Price** slider from 10 to 50 and watch the two lights: "P = MC" and "minimum ATC".

target.do: Find the price where both lights are on, then press Check.
target.hint: Keep moving the price slider until both lights are on.

takeaway: P = MC holds at every price; minimum ATC only when the price equals minimum ATC (here 26).
